text: The blaGUA-1 gene was cloned into Escherichia coli DH5a and the transformant showed a 64-fold increase in the ceftazidime MIC.
The blaGUA-1 gene was cloned into pET28a. MICs of ceftazidime increased 32-fold over the empty-vector control.
The ngt-1 knockout mutant showed a 16-fold decrease in the MIC of novobiocin compared with the parent strain.
Purified OXA-1422 enzyme hydrolysed nitrocefin with a catalytic efficiency of 0.2 per micromolar per second.
Conjugation transferred the blaKPC-249 plasmid to PAO1rifR and the transconjugant MIC rose to 64 mg/L.
